toolchain.profile: cargo release + -C overflow-checks=yes (opt-level 3, overflow-checks=yes, 16 codegen units, no LTO, unwind)

limits: Rust codegen unit objects (*.rcgu.o) only; native C/C++ objects are excluded.
Rust symbols are kept only when their mangled path names the producing crate (this includes core/alloc generics instantiated over that crate's own types).
Each body matches exactly one complete node115 .text FDE under relocation masking and exact psABI GOTPCRELX relaxations; no multi-copy credit is taken.
A match confirms that rustc 1.95.0 -C opt-level=3 -C overflow-checks=yes reproduces that body; it does not pin the whole crate version or feature set.
Relocation fields are masked, not resolved. No first-party component credit.
